cohort: The study included patients with unexplained recurrent implantation failure (uRIF) undergoing frozen embryo transfer (FET) in China between January 2014 and July 2021.
finding: The study found no significant difference in live birth rates or other pregnancy outcomes among the natural cycle, stimulated cycle, and artificial cycle endometrial preparation protocols in patients with unexplained recurrent implantation failure.
mod_finding: The artificial cycle (AC) protocol group showed a significantly higher Cesarean delivery rate compared to the natural cycle (NC) protocol group.
